minimumAdditionalEvidence.preferred: existing startup console or current run-log history, one Napi2NativeLoader failure line plus immediate Error/code/first stack lines; allow surrounding success marker only as needed

minimumAdditionalEvidence.privacy: only these native-loader lines, not whole account config/log exports; sanitize actual credentials and resource URLs/rkey before any archive
minimumAdditionalEvidence.ifAbsent: record missing first diagnostic; root decides whether any later startup capture window is necessary, no automatic restart or security change

currentConclusion: Offset support has advanced past prior rejection; current known blocker is the native addon loading guard. No exact runtime load cause or executable configuration/security repair is proved without its first startup error.
